in_hebrew.name: רוניקה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: From the Hebrew word 'rona', which means 'grace, mercy, compassion'. The name Ronnica can be interpreted as 'she who brings grace, mercy, and compassion'.

in_greek.name: Ροννικά
in_greek.long_meaning: The name Ronnica in Greek is derived from the word 'ronos', which means 'grace, mercy'. The name Ronnica can be translated as 'she who brings grace and mercy'.

in_latin.name: Ronnica
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Ronnica in Latin is a direct translation of the Greek name, which means 'grace, mercy'.
